interactives.label: Rules of the run
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the barrow field. Waystones count you out. The hall is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The joined barrows
interactives.text: Nine barrows and one road between them under the peat, dug so the families could visit their dead without crossing the moor at night.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Barrow Run
gauntlet.flavour: Nine barrows joined under the peat by the people who dug them, so the dead could visit. They still do.
